data.explanation: This is the bill for your move on 4 September 2026. Transfer €1,718.36 to the bank account printed on the invoice, quoting the invoice number. Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date, without deductions; the app shows the exact due date. If you don't pay on time, the company may send a reminder (Mahnung) and add fees. Keep the invoice: moving costs can sometimes be relevant for your tax return, for example for job-related moves.
